title: Working and caring by single parents in the Netherlands
descriptions: This study on the labour participation of single parents in the Netherlands consists of two surveys: (a) 1063 single mothers on welfare (1998) + (b) 1140 single parents (1999): 452 single mothers who also participated a year before, and 688 economically independent single parents.
The dataset, questionnaires and explanation are in Dutch, the codebook is in English.
